compile_note: GAP -- PREDICTED FALSE BLOCK. Intent covers the 4000 paise express delivery fee. The compilation policy authorizes product line items only and has no rule for fee reversal, so no action is emitted for it. An agent that refunds the fee is acting within the merchant's stated intent and WILL be blocked. That is a mandate-compilation failure, not a detector failure, and quantity 2 counts it as such.
intent_text: Make the customer whole for a late delivery that spoiled the milk. That means the milk at 6000 paise AND the 4000 paise express delivery fee they paid for a slot the driver missed.
